note: EVT-058 through EVT-063 are the open-banking-specific events. The JRN-002 payment execution events (EVT-P01 through EVT-P08) are fully reused in PH-039 — they are documented in the central event catalogue and are not duplicated here. See journey-detail.json DD-JRN010-03 for the design decision.

events.name: ConsentRequested
events.trigger: SVC-017 (channel) has called POST /open-banking-consents synchronously. SVC-001 has validated the TPP credentials (ENT-031 status = active), validated the payment details schema, and created an OpenBankingConsent with status = awaiting_auth. Published to enable downstream audit and monitoring consumers.

payload_schema.payee_name: string — payee name as provided by TPP

consumers.action: Writes event to the WORM audit pipeline. Provides an immutable record of consent creation for PSR 2017 compliance audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key on topic openbanking.consents.

events.name: ConsentAuthorised
events.trigger: The customer has completed SCA (via SVC-100) and confirmed the payment on the consent screen at PH-037. SVC-017 has notified SVC-001 of the authorisation. SVC-001 has atomically set ENT-030.status = authorised, ENT-030.sca_completed = true, ENT-030.authorised_at, ENT-030.customer_id, and ENT-030.account_id.

payload_schema.cop_result: string (optional) — enum: match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist

consumers.action: Writes to WORM audit pipeline. Evidence that PSD2 RTS dynamic-linked SCA was completed binding the customer to the specific payment amount and payee.
Sends a push notification to the customer confirming they have authorised an open banking payment consent. Provides the consent_id for traceability.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent strict ordering via consent_id partition key. Must be published after EVT-058 for the same consent_id.

events.name: ConsentRevoked
events.trigger: Published in two scenarios: (1) The customer declines the consent at PH-037 — SVC-001 sets ENT-030.status = revoked, revoked_at set, revocation_reason = customer_declined. (2) The customer revokes a previously authorised consent via the bank's consent dashboard before the TPP initiates the payment — SVC-001 sets ENT-030.status = revoked, revoked_at set, revocation_reason = customer_revoked_dashboard.

payload_schema.customer_id: string (UUID v4) — may be null if customer declined before identity was linked
payload_schema.revocation_reason: string — enum: customer_declined | customer_revoked_dashboard | tpp_requested | bank_administrative

consumers.action: WORM audit record of consent revocation. Required under PSR 2017 and UK GDPR right of withdrawal.
Notifies the customer that a consent has been revoked (if revoked via dashboard) or confirms their decision to decline (if declined at PH-037).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key on topic openbanking.consents.

events.name: OpenBankingPaymentInitiated
events.trigger: SVC-017 (channel) has called POST /payments on SVC-001 synchronously with a valid, authorised, non-expired consent_id. SVC-001 has validated account status (active), available balance, and daily payment limit. ENT-008 PaymentIntent is created with status = pending_screening and origination_channel = open_banking. ENT-030 status = consumed, consumed_at set. EVT-P01 (PaymentIntentCreated) is also published concurrently to trigger the JRN-002 payment execution chain. EVT-061 is the open-banking-specific wrapper that enables OB-domain consumers (TPP notification layer, Open Banking reporting) to subscribe without coupling to the core payment event stream.

payload_schema.payment_intent_id: string (UUID v4) — the internal PaymentIntent ID, returned as DomesticPaymentId to TPP

consumers.action: WORM audit record linking the OB consent to the PaymentIntent. Cross-reference for PSR 2017 and Open Banking Ltd reporting.
Sends an in-progress push notification to the customer: 'Your Open Banking payment to [payee_name] for [amount] is being processed.'

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-payment-intent ordering via payment_intent_id partition key on topic openbanking.payments. Published after EVT-059 (ConsentAuthorised) for the same consent_id.

events.name: OpenBankingPaymentCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-001 has consumed EVT-P05 (PaymentExecuted from SVC-009), debited the account ledger, and set PaymentIntent.status = completed. Published after EVT-P06 (AccountDebited) is confirmed. This is the OB-specific completion signal — SVC-017 consumes this event to update the OBIE payment status to AcceptedSettlementCompleted for the next TPP poll.

payload_schema.fps_reference: string — the Vocalink FPS transaction reference from PaymentExecution (ENT-009)

consumers.action: Updates the OB payment resource status cache. When the TPP polls GET /domestic-payments/{id}, SVC-017 returns AcceptedSettlementCompleted with the fps_reference.
Sends payment success push notification to PER-001: 'Your Open Banking payment of [amount] to [payee_name] was successful. Reference: [fps_reference].'
WORM audit record of OB payment completion. Includes FPS reference for scheme reconciliation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-payment-intent strict ordering via payment_intent_id partition key on topic openbanking.payments. Published after EVT-061 for the same payment_intent_id.

events.name: OpenBankingPaymentFailed
events.trigger: Published by SVC-001 when the open-banking-initiated PaymentIntent transitions to any terminal failure state during PH-039. Failure reasons: sanctions_blocked (EVT-P07 with reason sanctions_review consumed), fraud_blocked (EVT-P08 consumed), fps_rejection (SVC-009 receives FPS rejection response), fps_timeout (SVC-009 timeout after retry), insufficient_funds (SVC-001 validation failure at PH-038 — note: in this case EVT-P01 is not published and EVT-063 is the only OB failure signal). The failure_reason in the payload is mapped to a customer-safe message by SVC-017 — fraud and sanctions reasons are never disclosed verbatim to the TPP or customer.

payload_schema.payment_intent_id: string (UUID v4) — may be null if failure occurred before PaymentIntent was created (e.g. insufficient_funds at PH-038 validation)
payload_schema.failure_reason: string — enum: sanctions_blocked | fraud_blocked | fps_rejection | fps_timeout | insufficient_funds | daily_limit_exceeded | consent_expired | account_inactive. Internal use only — never forwarded verbatim to TPP.
payload_schema.obie_error_code: string — the OBIE-standard error code returned to the TPP in the GET status response (e.g. UK.OBIE.Rules.FailedRiskRules for fraud/sanctions; UK.OBIE.Field.Invalid for FPS rejection)

consumers.action: Updates the OB payment resource status to Rejected. Maps failure_reason to the appropriate obie_error_code for the TPP poll response. Must not expose fraud or sanctions detail in the API response.
Sends payment failure notification to PER-001 with a customer-safe message. Fraud and sanctions failure reasons are presented as 'payment could not be processed' only.
WORM audit record including the internal failure_reason. Retained for PSR 2017 and APP fraud reimbursement audit purposes.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key on topic openbanking.payments.
